say:1:1061602001:1.text: Ah! You need quick hands and sharp eyes for this game. No wonder young people are dominating this game.
say:1:1061602001:1.source_cn: 哎呀，还是你们年轻人玩得好，眼睛快，手也快。

say:2:1061602002:1.text: It seems I have a lot to learn... I wonder if I'll ever win a game against you.

say:3:1061602003:1.text: Thanks for playing with me. Here! Take this! A token of gratitude.
say:3:1061602003:1.source_cn: 谢谢你陪我这个老大叔打牌，这些东西就送给你吧。
